Use case: style-transfer. Edit target IMAGE 1: the complete existing forest map texture. IMAGE 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the game's approved tree and mossy-rock sprite atlas. Repaint IMAGE 1 into exactly the painterly pixel-art brushwork, foliage volume, soft-edged color clusters, warm olive-green palette and muted brown bark of IMAGE 2. Return only the complete map texture, no atlas and no text.
ABSOLUTELY LOCK the composition to image 1: same full frame, aspect64:44, camera projection, road centerlines and road widths, all clearing perimeters, grass islands, every pool outline and every water/stone shoreline coordinate. Do not add, remove, move, widen, narrow, or rotate any path, tree island, pool, bank, entrance, or landform. This image is overlaid on an existing collision map; geography cannot move even slightly. Edits are material/style only.
Replace the existing glossy dark blue-green giant individual leaf blobs with organic olive-green rounded canopy masses like the reference broadleaf and oak trees, made from smaller painterly lobes, broad coherent shadow planes, mossy natural trunks, restrained leaf tips. The baked forest edge crowns need to read as the same kind of trees as the reference props. Deep undersides are dark olive, NOT nearly-black navy. Match the reference warm upper-left sunlight and soft grouped midtones. No chunky black outlines or exaggerated highlight spots.
Repaint the path and grass into quieter earth and velvety moss materials matching the moss around the atlas roots. Strongly reduce the dense bright white/yellow scattered leaf-confetti texture; instead use a few coherent small patches of muted fallen leaves, low grass, moss and subdued gray-green stones. Keep the same broad illumination and footprint of paths; earth remains readable, matte warm ochre/brown with subtle worn gray stones. Water is unchanged in placement and stays clear deep blue-green with subtle texture, no new objects.
Preserve the high oblique top-down RPG perspective, with crowns seen from slightly above and visible trunks only where already present. Do not add independent tall trees, houses, shrines, monuments, creatures, loot, magic lights or giant flowers to walkable ground; existing runtime props are separate.
High-quality original raster game art. Crisp painterly pixel clusters, no blur, no photoreal grain, no artificial tiling grid. Full opaque canvas, no transparent border. Output as large and detailed as possible, ideally6144x4224, exact same64:44 aspect. The style reference is not meant to be pasted onto the map: redraw the entire existing texture in its visual language, preserving all land-water and route outlines.
